description: Database layer: bun:sqlite connection, full schema DDL, and automatic seed of REAL popular books priced in INR (stored as integer paise in the *_cents columns). Creates store.sqlite at the workspace root on first run, creating tables if absent and seeding sample data only when empty (idempotent). This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 (src/db dir, server boot). All money is integer paise; UI formats as ₹. Independent of auth/catalogue/cart logic — it only provides the schema + data + a thin typed query helper those FEATs build on.
steps: Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\db\index.ts: open a bun:sqlite Database at the workspace-root store.sqlite path (resolve relative to import.meta.dir / project root, NOT cwd), set PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL and PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON, export the db instance plus small helpers (e.g. prepared-statement wrappers). Allow an override path via env (e.g. DB_PATH) so tests can use ':memory:' or a temp file.

Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\db\schema.ts exporting initSchema(db) that runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for: users(id INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, gift_points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP); books(id, title, author, publisher, description, price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL /*paise*/, category, cover_url, stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rating REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, delivery_lead_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, created_at); addresses(id, user_id NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), label, recipient, line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, country, is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0); carts(id, user_id UNIQUE NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)); cart_items(id, cart_id NOT NULL REFERENCES carts(id), book_id NOT NULL REFERENCES books(id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(cart_id, book_id)); orders(id, user_id NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), address_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL /*JSON of chosen address*/, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','paid','cancelled')), payment_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MOCK', subtotal_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, points_redeemed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, points_earned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, placed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cancellable_until TEXT NOT NULL /*placed_at + 48h, computed at insert*/); order_items(id, order_id NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id), book_id NOT NULL REFERENCES books(id), title TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT NOT NULL, unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL). Add helpful indexes (books.category, books.publisher, addresses.user_id, orders.user_id, cart_items.cart_id).

Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\db\seed.ts exporting seedIfEmpty(db): if SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books == 0, insert ~18-24 REAL popular books across several categories (e.g. Fiction, Fantasy, Science Fiction, Mystery/Thriller, Self-Help, Business, History) and several real PUBLISHERS (e.g. Penguin, HarperCollins, Bloomsbury, Vintage, Scribner, Random House). Each book: real title + author + publisher, a short description, price_cents in paise using realistic INR points (~₹150-₹1500, i.e. 15000-150000 paise), category, a WORKING hotlinked public cover_url (stable image URL for the real cover), stock (varying, some low), rating (3.5-5.0), delivery_lead_days (3-7). Use well-known covers so the storefront, category browse, publisher browse, and recommendations are populated immediately. Do NOT seed users (auth FEAT handles that).

Wire schema+seed into startup: in src\db\index.ts (or called from src/server.ts before serve) call initSchema(db) then seedIfEmpty(db) so first run creates and seeds store.sqlite automatically, and subsequent runs are no-ops.

Create c:\Users\PravallikaP\Documents\FDE capstone\online_bookstore\src\db\db.test.ts: using a fresh ':memory:' or temp DB_PATH, run initSchema + seedIfEmpty and assert (a) all tables exist, (b) books count > 0, (c) at least 4 distinct categories and 3 distinct publishers exist, (d) every seeded book has a non-empty cover_url and price_cents > 0, (e) seedIfEmpty is idempotent (running twice does not duplicate rows).
acceptance_criteria: On first server boot, store.sqlite is created at the workspace root with all tables and seeded books; a second boot does not duplicate seed data.
Seeded catalog contains real popular books across >=4 categories and >=3 publishers, each with a working cover_url and INR price stored as paise in price_cents.
Running `bun test` passes the db schema+seed tests including the idempotency and cover_url/price assertions.
verification: Run `bun test` (or `bun test src/db`) and confirm the schema/seed tests pass.
Run `bunx tsc --noEmit` and confirm zero errors.

Boot the server background/bounded, then Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:3000/api/books once FEAT-004 exists; for this FEAT alone, assert store.sqlite is created and non-empty via a tiny bun one-liner script that opens it and counts books. Stop the server afterward.
findings:
MONEY UNIT: all *_cents columns store INTEGER paise (1 INR = 100 paise); e.g. ₹499 => 49900. Never store floats. UI divides by 100 and formats with ₹. This applies to books.price_cents, orders.subtotal_cents/total_cents, order_items.unit_price_cents.

DB MODULE (src/db/index.ts): exports `db` (shared singleton bun:sqlite Database opened at import time), `openDb(path?)`, and `initDb(database=db)` which runs initSchema then seedIfEmpty (both idempotent). DB file resolves to workspace-root store.sqlite via import.meta.dir (NOT cwd); override with env DB_PATH (tests use ':memory:'). PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON always; journal_mode=WAL except for ':memory:'. server.ts calls initDb() before Bun.serve so first boot provisions+seeds and later boots are no-ops.

SCHEMA (src/db/schema.ts initSchema(db)): tables users, books, addresses, carts, cart_items, orders, order_items created with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. Notes for later FEATs: users.gift_points INTEGER default 0 (points FEAT), users NOT seeded here (auth FEAT seeds). carts.user_id UNIQUE (one cart per user). cart_items UNIQUE(cart_id, book_id). orders.status CHECK IN ('pending','paid','cancelled'), payment_method default 'MOCK', orders.cancellable_until must be set at insert to placed_at+48h (schema does not compute it). order_items snapshots title/author/unit_price_cents at purchase time. Indexes: books(category), books(publisher), addresses(user_id), orders(user_id), cart_items(cart_id).

SEED (src/db/seed.ts seedIfEmpty(db)): inserts 23 real popular books only when books table is empty (idempotent via COUNT guard, wrapped in a transaction). 7 categories (Fiction, Fantasy, Science Fiction, Mystery/Thriller, Self-Help, Business, History), 21 distinct publishers. cover_url uses stable public Open Library covers: https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/isbn/<ISBN>-L.jpg (verified HTTP 200 image/jpeg). Prices 29900-89900 paise (₹299-₹899). stock varies (some low e.g. 5-9), rating 4.0-4.9, delivery_lead_days 3-7.

VERIFIED: `bun test src/db` 5/5 pass; `bunx tsc --noEmit` clean; store.sqlite auto-created at root (gitignored, NOT committed) with 23 books across 7 categories/21 publishers; re-init does not duplicate (count stays 23).
